name: early growth response 1

function.text: EGR1 encodes early growth response protein 1. Annotated molecular activities include DNA-binding transcription factor activity and DNA-binding transcription activator activity, RNA polymerase II-specific. It participates in positive regulation of DNA-templated transcription and positive regulation of miRNA transcription.

germline.text: No constitutional disease assertion was retrieved in the reviewed GenCC snapshot; this does not exclude a germline association.
